label: Offline demo — sample data. All projects, pages, claims, and dates below are fictional test data.
requirement: Find self-hosted open-source PDF parsing projects that support table extraction, show recent maintenance activity, and use a permissive licence.

interpretation.summary: Sample scenario: self-hosted PDF parsing with documented table extraction and permissive licensing; prefer repository activity since 2026-05-25. This six-month window is a demo assumption, not a project-quality test.

criteria.label: Recent repository activity
criteria.description: Preference: activity on or after 2026-05-25; release dates recorded separately; recency is not quality
